instructions.question: The state is an existing playbook entry. `candidate` is a one-line summary of a new finding. Would a reader who acts on `candidate` take the same executable action as a reader of the existing entry? Answer yes only if the actions are the same even though the wording or the example differs; answer no if the candidate leads to a different action.

criteria.true: Same executable action: the candidate is a re-confirmation of the existing entry (would be recorded as Helpful +1, not as a new entry).
criteria.false: Different executable action: a reader of the existing entry would not already do what the candidate says (would be a new entry).
